The only previous meetings between these clubs were for the two-legged Intertoto Cup Final of 1999, which Juve won 4-2 on aggregate.

The tension is sky high after a 3-0 home defeat to Lazio, yet in the Europa League it is a completely different story, Juventus beating NEC 5-0 and completing a comeback 2-1 victory away to Celta Vigo.

"Every day produces something new, every day has meetings, discussions, even clashes at times, but that evening you wipe the slate clean, because if you don't do that, the next day things pile up in your mind and it becomes difficult to deal with," Spalletti told Sky Sport Italia.

"We hope that we wiped the slate clean, we can focus on the next game, try to give the best indications, and hope for the optimal response also based on the things that they said. The players said some things, and I liked many of them, so we want to put this into practice."

For the first time, Woltemade and Kolo Muani start together upfront, a situation that both strikers had made public appeals for several times in recent weeks.

The coach listened and decided to launch the pair in a new 3-5-2 formation, although it could be a 3-4-1-2 with Weston McKennie in a free role.

TURIN, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 20: Luciano Spalletti, Manager of Juventus, looks on before the Serie A match between Juventus and Atalanta BC at Allianz Stadium on September 20, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images)

"The pitch always tells the truth. We've got to pay attention to the characteristics of the players and try to make the most of them. Nobody would be crazy enough to use Edon Zhegrova as a right-back, so we have to set out a system that will get the best out of their strengths."

It was put to Spalletti that football is not just finding the best players, but creating that combination so that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.

"That is very wise, because a players has to consider how much do you press, when to use this move, how many times I want to get to the edge of their penalty area and leave space behind to risk a counter-attack, which forces me to track back towards our box? Am I supported by the team when I start that press, or am I creating a division between the sectors that opponents can run into?

"These are all matters we discuss in training and work on, because it's not a lack of courage, it's about considering the risk and benefit of certain movement that leaves space for your opponents. There are players who are more suited to helping the team and providing coverage, but give you less unpredictability."

FROSINONE, ITALY – AUGUST 23: Luciano Spalletti head coach of FC Juventus looks dejected during the Serie A match between Frosinone Calcio and Juventus FC at Stadio Benito Stirpe on August 23, 2026 in Frosinone, Italy. (Photo by Giuseppe Bellini/Getty Images)

Spalletti then referenced the jeers that the crowd rained down on the Juventus squad after their humiliating 3-0 home defeat to Lazio, and the Bremer comments about teammates who 'hide' in high-pressure situations.

"It's about finding the balance between all those elements, and then as you in the media always say, this jersey weighs heavily, people are not happy, but we carried those jeers with us into the locker room. We jeered ourselves in there.

"The conscience of the players jeers in the silence of the locker room, so difficulties always force you to ask yourself a question: What person do you become under pressure? Are you the one who pushes forward, goes to get the next ball and wants to dig your way out of trouble, or are you afraid and therefore cannot stay within a club like this?

"This is the question that you have to ask yourself."

TURIN, ITALY – APRIL 19: Luciano Spalletti, Head Coach of Juventus, reacts prior to the Serie A match between Juventus FC and Bologna FC 1909 at Allianz Stadium on April 19, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images)

It is not just the Juventus jersey that weighs heavily, but also the touchline is a dangerous place to be for any coach.

"Well yes, the bench is burning after a week, because the more coaches you get fired, the better for news. That has always been the case, there are many more against us than there are for us," replied Spalletti.

"Beware, because I always prefer to start again rather than give up, so be careful or you'll find something to chew on. Munch, munch, munch."

articles.title: 'Looksmaxxing' influencer Clavicular pleads not guilty to rape charge
articles.summary: The influencer, whose real name is Braden Peters, is accused of sexually assaulting a 17-year-old girl in 2025.
articles.body:
Clavicular, a social media influencer who promotes the "looksmaxxing" trend of young men maximising their attractiveness, has pleaded not guilty to criminal charges including rape.

The 20-year-old, whose real name is Braden Peters, was charged in September with felony rape, drugging an individual for sexual intercourse and procuring alcohol for someone under the age of 21.

The charges stem from an incident in 2025 when he is accused of assaulting a 17-year-old girl at his family's Massachusetts home.

Peters has denied the allegations and said the encounter was consensual. On Thursday, he was granted $10,000 bail, ordered not to contact or post about his accuser, and to surrender his passport.

A woman told police that on 23 May 2025, Peters ordered her an Uber to his family's house in Chatham where they were drinking alcohol while filming a livestream before he allegedly raped her, according to the BBC's US partner, CBS News.

The police officer who took the report said he believed she was unable to consent due to her age and the level of intoxication she exhibited in the livestream, CBS reported.

Clavicular has more than a million followers on TikTok and Instagram and has garnered media attention for extreme measures he has taken for "looksmaxxing".

He has admitted to using a hammer on his face and jawline and taking a number of steroids, injections, and other drugs to achieve bodily perfection. He also gives advice on appearing masculine and performs stunts to shock followers.

In Florida earlier this year, he was charged after filming himself shooting at what appeared to be a dead alligator. He pleaded no contest to unlawfully discharging a firearm in public.

In March, he was arrested on suspicion of battery after authorities suspected him of instigating a fight between two women. Authorities said in July that they did not intend to file charges.

After Thursday's hearing, Peters posted a photo of himself in the black suit and black tie he wore to court, while holding his dog which he also brought to court.

His next hearing will be on 24 November, when the judge will decide if there is enough evidence for the case to move forward.

During an appearance on "Great Company with Jamie Laing," Jack recalled how doctors urged the Black Sabbath frontman not to take the stage at his farewell concert due to serious health concerns. "They basically were just saying like you've got so many things going on," Jack explained. "We recommend you don't do this because the energy expenditure." .OZZY OSBOURNE KNEW THE END WAS NEAR DURING FINAL PERFORMANCE, FRIEND SAYS Jack revealed that his father had been dealing with multiple medical complications leading up to the show. Despite the warnings, the Prince of Darkness was determined to give fans one final performance. articles.title: Tom Skerritt, star of ‘Alien’ and ‘Top Gun,’ dies at 93
articles.summary: Tom Skerritt, a prolific actor who won an Emmy playing a hard-working sheriff in “Picket Fences” and also appeared in hit Hollywood movies like “Top Gun” and “Alien,” has died, his family confirmed Thursday.
articles.body: Tom Skerritt, a prolific actor who won an Emmy playing a hard-working sheriff in “Picket Fences” and also appeared in hit Hollywood movies like “Top Gun” and “Alien,” has died, his family confirmed Thursday. He was 93. Skerritt died Wednesday of natural causes, his family said in a statement provided to NBC News. “While the world knew Tom through his remarkable acting career, we knew him for his humor, curiosity, wisdom, generosity, and the love he brought into our lives,” the family said. “He cared deeply about imagination, creativity, storytelling, service, veterans, the natural world, and helping others find and share their own voices.” Born Aug. 25, 1933, in Detroit, Skerritt landed in Hollywood after serving four years in the U.S. Air Force intending to become a director. But with his lean frame and weather-beaten good looks, Skerritt quickly found his place in front of the camera. His breakthrough role was playing Captain Duke Forrest in Robert Altman’s 1970 satirical war movie “M*A*S*H.” That led to starring roles in a string of successful movies like “The Turning Point,” “Up in Smoke,” “The Dead Zone” and “Steel Magnolias.” But Skerritt was best known to moviegoers as Tom Cruise’s no-nonsense flight instructor in the 1986 blockbuster “Top Gun” and the doomed Captain Dallas in the 1979 science-fiction classic “Alien.” Skerritt was also widely praised for his role as a stern minister in the 1992 Robert Redford movie “A River Runs Through It,” which won an Oscar for best cinematography. Later, Skerritt made his mark on the small screen playing Sheriff Jimmy Brock on the family dramedy “Picket Fences” from 1992 to 1996. In later years, Skerritt branched out and started Heyou Media in 2016, a digital entertainment and content-aggregation company based in Seattle. He was 84 at the time. “This is a new era and we’re positioning ourselves to bring some light to new media and digital entertainment,” the actor told The Seattle Times. “My frame of reference is as big as this room.” Skerritt is survived by his wife Julie, five children, five grandchildren, and two great-grandchildren. “We are heartbroken by his loss,” the family said in their statement.

articles.title: Pedro Sánchez ofrece la renovación de 'La Revuelta' a David Broncano: "Aspiro a renovar cuatro años y os ofrezco seguir cuatro años"
articles.standfirst: El presidente del Gobierno ha visitado por primera vez el plató de 'La Revuelta', donde ha bromeado con David Broncano sobre el futuro del programa y ha defendido el papel de la televisión pública
articles.summary: El presidente del Gobierno ha visitado por primera vez el plató de 'La Revuelta', donde ha bromeado con David Broncano sobre el futuro del programa y ha defendido el papel de la televisión pública
articles.body: Pedro Sánchez ha visitado este jueves 'La Revuelta', el programa de David Broncano en La 1, en una entrevista marcada por el humor, las referencias políticas y algunas confesiones personales. El presidente del Gobierno ha acudido al plató con un estilismo informal, compuesto por camisa vaquera, pantalón vaquero, cinturón negro y zapatos, y ha aprovechado su primera conversación cara a cara con el presentador para bromear sobre el futuro del espacio y ofrecerle una particular propuesta de continuidad. "Luego me dicen a mí que esta televisión es mía. Menudo recibimiento, David", ha comentado Pedro Sánchez al comienzo de su intervención. A continuación, ha lanzado una oferta al presentador, que ha anunciado en varias ocasiones que esta será la última temporada del programa. "Vas diciendo que esta es la última temporada. Yo aspiro a renovar cuatro años y, si eso pasa y 'La Revuelta' quiere, os ofrezco seguir cuatro años", ha afirmado. El jefe del Ejecutivo ha aprovechado también para reivindicar la función de la televisión pública más allá de la información. "El servicio público de la televisión pública también es hacer reír con humor inteligente y que la gente se vaya a la cama feliz", ha defendido. La entrevista ha dejado espacio para abordar la relación del presidente con otros dirigentes socialistas y expresidentes del Gobierno. Pedro Sánchez se ha mostrado especialmente crítico con José María Aznar, al que ha reprochado sus declaraciones y su trayectoria al frente del Ejecutivo. "Lo de Aznar es tremendo. Él cuando estuvo los ocho años y todo lo que salió, no está para dar lecciones", ha indicado. El presidente también ha recordado cómo fue su primer contacto con el expresidente popular después de ganar la moción de censura que desalojó a Mariano Rajoy de La Moncloa en 2018. Según ha relatado, llegó al complejo presidencial durante un fin de semana y recibió una llamada de Aznar, que fue el primer expresidente en ponerse en contacto con él. "Me dijo que se ponía a mi servicio, pero luego todo mentira", ha asegurado. Pedro Sánchez también ha desvelado que habló con todos los expresidentes cuando comenzó la invasión rusa de Ucrania en febrero de 2022 para conocer su valoración de la situación. En ese contexto, ha afirmado que todos se equivocaron al pronosticar una rápida derrota ucraniana: "Muchos dijeron que Ucrania iba a caer en unas semanas y llevamos cuatro años". También ha hablado de Felipe González, el dirigente socialista que despertó su interés por la política cuando era joven y que le llevó a afiliarse al PSOE. "Yo le digo que me afilié al PSOE por Felipe González. Me gustó el Felipe de los 80, cuando yo era un chaval. Ahora mismo no me siento muy identificado con él", ha manifestado. Otro de los asuntos abordados durante la conversación ha sido la seguridad de sus dispositivos electrónicos. Pedro Sánchez ha asegurado que, si le han hackeado algún contenido, se trataría de fotografías familiares. Además, ha recomendado desconectar el teléfono durante unos minutos al día, una práctica que, según ha explicado, ayudaría a proteger el dispositivo frente a los virus. "Si me han hackeado algo son fotos familiares", ha apuntado. Sobre los teléfonos móviles, ha añadido: "Si vosotros, al día cinco minutos apagáis el móvil, eso hace que el móvil se proteja ante los virus. Los móviles con mucha actividad, sobre todo". El presidente también ha explicado cómo se mantiene informado y qué periódicos consulta habitualmente. Pedro Sánchez ha afirmado que lee medios como La Vanguardia, El País, elDiario.es o infoLibre. En cambio, ha bromeado con que deja la lectura de OK Diario o The Objective en manos de la Secretaría de Estado de Comunicación, para que sea este departamento el que le informe sobre sus contenidos. "Yo no tengo por qué amargarme la vida", ha dicho al explicar su relación con las cabeceras informativas. La visita de Pedro Sánchez se produce en plena precampaña de las elecciones generales del próximo 29 de noviembre y después de que Broncano invitara públicamente a los principales candidatos a pasar por el programa. El presidente del Gobierno se ha convertido así en el primero de los aspirantes a la presidencia del Gobierno en acudir al espacio tras el adelanto electoral. Durante la entrevista, Pedro Sánchez ha combinado las referencias a su futuro político con comentarios sobre sus relaciones con otros dirigentes, sus hábitos informativos y la seguridad de sus dispositivos. Una conversación que también ha servido para que el jefe del Ejecutivo reivindique el entretenimiento como parte del servicio público y deje abierta, en tono de humor, la posibilidad de que 'La Revuelta' continúe en antena durante otros cuatro años.

articles.title: Manuel Otto, German video game creator, dies after apparently livestreaming his suicide
articles.summary: German video game designer and influencer Manuel Otto apparently took his own life while doing a livestream on Twitch, according to the streaming platform and his colleagues.
articles.body: German video game designer and influencer Manuel Otto apparently took his own life while doing a livestream on Twitch, according to the streaming platform and his colleagues. He was 30. Otto was a 14-year-old high school student when he created his most famous game, Stick Run. The free Facebook game, later an app for Android and Apple, was played by tens of millions of people. His body was found Tuesday after authorities responded to reports of a blaze in an attic room on a property in the Bavarian village of Breitbrunn am Chiemsee, German outlet Bild reported. His death was later confirmed by his colleagues on social media. “It is with a heavy heart that we confirm and announce the passing of our creator, developer, and fellow Stick Runner, Marc-Manuel Alexander Otto,” the Stick Run Team posted Wednesday on Facebook. An earlier post from the Stick Run Team said Otto “appeared to take his own life” in a livestream. Videos of the livestream later posted online appear to show Otto setting himself on fire. Meanwhile, a Twitch spokesperson said in an emailed statement to NBC News that they “moved quickly to remove the channel and Video on Demand (VOD) to prevent it from being viewed by others.” “What took place is horrible, and the mental health and wellbeing of our community matters deeply to us,” the spokesperson said. “We encourage anyone who may be struggling to seek support.” Otto launched his signature game, in which players control a stick figure running through obstacle courses, in 2010 on Facebook. Since then, Stick Run has been played by more than 43 million people worldwide, according to Dexerto, a digital media company that covers video games. “Thank you, Manuel, for being a part of our childhood,” the Stick Run Team said in its post. “You will never be forgotten.” If you or someone you know is in crisis, call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline or chat live at 988lifeline.org. articles.summary: El conductor de 'Carrusel Deportivo' ha sido el invitado de Pablo Motos este jueves en 'El Hormiguero'
articles.body: 'El Hormiguero' ha despedido la semana con la visita del periodista Paco González, con quien Pablo Motos ha hablado de su paso atrás en la primera línea de la radio y de su dilatada trayectoria, que suma casi cuatro décadas, desde su comienzo con 25 años de edad al frente de 'Carrusel Deportivo'. PABLO MOTOS. Después de 40 años disimulando, te voy a preguntar, ¿de qué equipo eres? Juan del Val dice que eres del Real Madrid. PACO GONZÁLEZ. Juan es un listo, yo soy de corazón del Oviedo, que es mi equipo de sangre. Creo que no es tan importante el periodista, sino lo que cuenta el periodista. No me gusta nada el periodismo de bufanda. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Cómo es eso de que te vas de la radio, pero no te vas del todo? PACO GONZÁLEZ. Yo voy a dar un pasito al lado, para que pasen los 'Ferraris'. Voy a seguir en la Cope, en Tiempo de juego, pero voy a estar menos. Voy a cumplir 60 años, mi sueño ideal era irme con Pepe Domingo Castaño cuando él lo decidiera. Pepe Domingo se nos fue hace tres años y, en ese momento, no era el ideal para retirarme. Me sentía como el papá porque nos habíamos quedado huérfanos sin él, tenía que tirar del carro. Ahora hay una excelente cantera y creo que sí que puede ser el momento. Quiero dedicarle más tiempo y más tiempo de calidad a mi familia y a mis amigos. Quiero cuidarme un poco. Me paso el día entero pensando en el programa, no desconecto, y eso quiero cambiarlo. PABLO MOTOS. Quiero hablar de Pepe Domingo, murió un sábado de madrugada y, al día siguiente, tuvisteis que hacer el programa sin él. PACO GONZÁLEZ. Fue un día horrible. Estábamos a punto de acostarnos y nos llamó su familia para decirnos que estaba muy mal, y nos fuimos al hospital a despedirnos, falleció esa misma noche. Al día siguiente, el equipo salió para delante como pudo, no nos lo esperábamos para nada. Ese día fue la zona cero del dolor, luego, tiempo después, tengo bajones cada vez que me doy cuenta de que no está de viaje, de que no va a volver. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Qué pasó para que te echaran de la SER siendo líder de audiencia y no te dejaran ni recoger las cosas? PACO GONZÁLEZ. Lo cuento sin ningún rencor, porque estoy muy agradecido a la SER. En aquel momento teníamos unos jefes que, desde mi punto de vista, no estaban a la altura. Habían sancionado sin empleo y sueldo un mes a mi compañero Jorge Hevia por una broma que había hecho en directo. Me parecía muy mala decisión, era un padre de familia y tenía un sueldo muy bajo. Me enfrenté a los jefes y me acabé yendo. PABLO MOTOS. En la radio te llaman 'Nostrapacus' porque siempre que haces un pronóstico sale lo contrario, ¿a quién vas a votar en estas elecciones?, ¿vas a votar con ilusión? PACO GONZÁLEZ. Sí, es un don que tengo. Yo suelo votar a la contra, voto en contra del que gobierne en ese momento, me gusta la alternancia. Yo creo en determinadas personas, pero no en los partidos. Votar con ilusión, pues no mucha, lo que no me gusta es que estemos enfrentados entre amigos, entre vecinos, entre familia, solo por el color del partido al que votemos.
